# Ahmet Kazankaya

> AI automation engineer based in Istanbul, Turkey. Builds the platform layer that makes LLM agents safe to run in production: execution runtimes, human approval gates, permission boundaries, run logging and evaluation harnesses. Ships native macOS, iOS, Windows and web tools as a solo builder. Open to full-time roles in Europe, on site or remote.

Ahmet Kazankaya works as a solo product builder: product and interface design, implementation and testing, with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) as part of the process. A task management system built for Türkiye Maarif Vakfı, a foundation operating schools in 66 countries, has been in production for four months. Other running work includes an Etsy and Printify automation line with a Telegram approval gate, an ESP32-S3 desk robot with a speech pipeline, and open source Claude Code skill sets that other people install.

Skills: LLM agent orchestration, workflow automation, evaluation harnesses, CI reliability gates, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, Python, TypeScript, Swift and SwiftUI, FastAPI, Next.js, Docker, AWS, ESP32 firmware. Languages: Turkish, English.

Contact: ahmetkazankaya1@gmail.com, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmetkazankaya), [GitHub](https://github.com/kasparovabi).

## Products

- [Gecit](https://kasparovabi.github.io/gecit/): shares one keyboard, mouse and clipboard between a Windows PC and a Mac over the local network; free, with a one-time Pro license for file drag and drop
- [Gecit privacy policy](https://kasparovabi.github.io/gecit/privacy.html)

## Open source

- [Sift](https://github.com/kasparovabi/sift): native macOS app that indexes local Claude Code and Codex session transcripts for full text search
- [DSH Studio](https://github.com/kasparovabi/dsh-studio): unofficial native macOS client for dsh, the DeepSeek agent harness
- [Cutaway](https://github.com/kasparovabi/cutaway): native macOS app that transcribes a video and matches short clips to every sentence
- [Busted](https://github.com/kasparovabi/busted): a Mac desk guard that catches snoops
- [claude-audit-20](https://github.com/kasparovabi/claude-audit-20): guard-20 and audit-20 for Claude Code, twenty AI coding failure classes as write time rules plus a twenty pass verification gate with a false positive filter
- [motion-first-design](https://github.com/kasparovabi/motion-first-design): Claude Code skill for motion first web design, published with the blind ablation that proved its first version wrong
- [claude-file-bridge](https://github.com/kasparovabi/claude-file-bridge): uploads real files to a page when browser automation file upload is broken
- [embeddinggemma2-rag-test](https://github.com/kasparovabi/embeddinggemma2-rag-test): EmbeddingGemma 2 GGUF settings for RAG compared against each other and BM25
- [strands-decider-eval](https://github.com/kasparovabi/strands-decider-eval): AWS Strands Decider 2B tested on 501 real CI failures and 500 Wordle games
- [iMenu timing fix](https://github.com/meyusufdemirci/iMenu-MacOS/pull/1): event ordering fix merged upstream into a macOS menu bar manager
- [claude-mythos-scaffold](https://github.com/kasparovabi/claude-mythos-scaffold): retired August 2026, agent persistence scaffold for older Claude models

## Security research

- [Security research](https://kasparovabi.github.io/security-research/): coordinated disclosures and security writeups
- [Omi disclosure](https://kasparovabi.github.io/security-research/2026-04-omi-disclosure.html): seventeen vulnerabilities in the Omi wearable backend, CVSS 10.0, coordinated disclosure timeline
